title: Route Boolean-sector query families with O(n log n) ordinary work
body:
The published T7 sector family can use one query per block, but its generic compiler uses quadratic ordinary work. This package gives an explicit butterfly route for every `n=2^s` and every number of disjoint blocks, with all ADDs and shifts charged.

For the same input-preserving contract at 32 sectors, the circuit uses **994 ADDs and 160 pure shifts instead of 2,080 ADDs**, with the same one query, 34 CLEARs, and 33 extra fields including outputs. The in-place variant uses one extra field and two CLEARs; the native projector gauge needs none. The query count is optimal in the faithful-sector model. The workspace and CLEAR counts are sharp only in the stated dyadic ADD/shift/query/CLEAR alphabet. Arbitrary nonunit scalar overwrites are outside that storage proof.

- [Proof and instruction-model limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/96278e8cdfe2aadb16024e6ee2c7deaebd4ed484/research/sector-routing-butterfly/PROOF.md)
- [Exact result and cost tables](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/96278e8cdfe2aadb16024e6ee2c7deaebd4ed484/research/sector-routing-butterfly/RESULT.json)
- [Source pins and attribution](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/96278e8cdfe2aadb16024e6ee2c7deaebd4ed484/research/sector-routing-butterfly/PINS.json)

Validation: registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays pass: 28 full-column group-ring maps, five retained-input maps, 48 exact native-address cases, a reverse-adjoint oracle, five changed-word rejection controls, and a nonunit-scale scope control. All 15 committed files match working bytes; export integrity and a Git-free scientific replay pass. The general construction and polynomial prefix/suffix bound are proved separately from the finite tests. Full source-history preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout.

This builds on [PR5626](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5626), Dugongue's [PR5578](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5578) T6/T7, PR5586 C8, PR5615, and their retained authors. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human review is claimed.

Canonical base `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7. Fresh main and remote overlap checks found no competing sector-routing scope; sparse local coverage was supplemented by the all-main note search. The claim is in Discussion5623. This does not supply a profitable complete caller, physical tape price or native arithmetic-interior precision certificate. **No new kappa; selected .00310045 is unchanged.** The current baseline planning job has two unrelated missing-link assertions; hosted replay may remain blocked until those are repaired.
